any input carrying `control_after_generate`, so a V1 node with N required
inputs stores N+1 values when exactly one input has the flag.

required.name: model_pack_name
required.tooltip: Select the Chatterbox voice model pack to use for generation.

required.name: text
required.default: Hello, this is a test of Chatterbox TTS in ComfyUI.
required.tooltip: Text to be synthesized into speech.

required.name: max_new_tokens
required.tooltip: Maximum number of audio tokens to generate. 25 tokens ≈ 1 second. The hard limit is 4096 tokens (≈ 163 seconds).

required.name: flow_cfg_scale
required.tooltip: CFG scale for the mel spectrogram decoder (flow matching). Higher values increase adherence to content and timbre but may reduce naturalness.

required.name: exaggeration
required.tooltip: Controls the expressiveness and emotional intensity. Higher values lead to more exaggerated prosody.

required.name: temperature
required.tooltip: Controls the randomness of the sampling process. Higher values produce more diverse speech, while lower values are more deterministic.

required.name: cfg_weight
required.tooltip: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) weight. Controls how strongly the model adheres to the text prompt. Higher values may reduce naturalness.

required.name: repetition_penalty
required.tooltip: Penalizes repeated tokens to discourage monotonous or repetitive speech. A value of 1.0 means no penalty.

required.name: min_p
required.tooltip: Sets a minimum probability threshold for nucleus sampling (Min-P). Filters out tokens with very low probability.

required.name: top_p
required.tooltip: Nucleus sampling (Top-P) parameter. The model samples from the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds this value.

required.name: seed
required.tooltip: Seed for random number generation. A value of 0 will use a random seed.

required.name: use_watermark
required.tooltip: Enable or disable the audio watermark. Requires 'resemble-perth' to be installed.

required.name: model_pack_name
required.tooltip: Select the Chatterbox voice model pack to use for conversion.

required.name: source_audio
required.tooltip: The audio containing the speech content to be converted.

required.name: n_timesteps
required.tooltip: Number of diffusion steps for the flow matching process. Higher values may improve quality at the cost of speed.

required.name: temperature
required.tooltip: Controls the randomness of the initial noise. 1.0 is standard. Lower values are more deterministic.

required.name: flow_cfg_scale
required.tooltip: CFG scale for the mel spectrogram decoder. Higher values increase adherence to the target voice but may reduce naturalness.

required.name: use_watermark
required.tooltip: Enable or disable the audio watermark. Requires 'resemble-perth' to be installed.

optional.name: target_voice_audio
optional.tooltip: The audio file containing the target voice timbre. If not provided, the default voice from the model pack will be used.
